5056486887166.sourceDescription:
Add a soft, wintry ambience to your indoor festive decorating with this set of two pre-lit birch effect table top trees. Each decorative tree features a slim white trunk and branches finished with subtle black bark-style markings, capturing the natural charm of silver birch in a compact size. The matching pair creates a coordinated seasonal display that blends effortlessly with Christmas greenery and holiday ornaments.

Fitted with warm white LED lights along the branches and tips, these trees arrive pre-lit so you can display them immediately without untangling separate light strings. Delicate wire tips extend from the ends of the branches, creating an airy, twig-like texture that glows gently when illuminated. Each tree is supported by its own sturdy white square base, ensuring stable freestanding positioning.

With a combined weight of 1500 g, these versatile table top trees are ideally suited for decorating sideboards, mantelpieces, shelves, console tables or dining room surfaces. Arrange them as a pair to frame a mirror, or position them individually across living rooms, hallways and bedrooms to spread inviting festive cheer throughout your home.
Matching pair: Supplied as a set of two pre-lit artificial birch effect trees designed to bring a wintry glow to your home.
Birch bark finish: Each tree features a white trunk and branches detailed with realistic black bark markings for an authentic woodland look.
Warm white LEDs: Energy-efficient LED lights are positioned along the branches and tips, eliminating the need for separate string lighting.
Delicate wire tips: Fine wire tips extend gently from the branch ends, producing an attractive and delicate twig-like appearance when illuminated.
Square base stand: Each tree stands securely on its own white square base, enabling stable freestanding placement on flat surfaces.
Table top placement: Perfectly proportioned for styling across sideboards, mantelpieces, shelves, console tables or dining room cabinets throughout the holidays.
Indoor festive styling: Ideal for creating an inviting seasonal accent in living rooms, dining spaces, hallways or bedrooms during Christmas celebrations.
Combined product weight: The complete two-piece pack weighs 1500 g, providing a well-balanced and lightweight decorative lighting arrangement for tabletops.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

4313817035766.sourceDescription:
The evening before a family gathering, the wall behind the table is still bare and the plan was to hang plain string lights. Then the curtain goes up instead. Four hundred RGB LEDs on a fine mesh paint a pattern onto the wall, a greeting can be typed
 straight from the app, and the display keeps time with the music playing in the room. Hanging takes minutes on quick-release hooks, and once the season ends the whole thing rolls away and stores flat.



Feature - A 400 RGB LED smart curtain, phone app control, a 32-button remote, USB plug-in power and multi-panel connection.

Advantage - Because each LED is individually addressable, the curtain shows real text, pictures and animation instead of a single flat wash of light, and the app handles brightness, speed and pattern changes in seconds.



Benefit - One decoration covers holidays, birthdays and everyday ambience: a Christmas greeting on the porch in December, a welcome message on the bedroom wall in June, and a synchronised light show for a party.



【Product Specifications】

Product Name: Smart Light Curtain

Material: PVC

Size:2x2m

Number of LEDs: 400

Power Supply: Direct USB Plug-In

Power: 5V-2A / 10W

Lifespan: Approx. 20,000 Hours

Control Type: Remote Control, App Control

Dynamic Modes: 6

Timer: 6-Hour And 8-Hour Auto Shut-Off, With Memory Function

Installation Method: Hooks

Rated Operating Temperature: Approx. -20°C To 40°C

Usage: Atmospheric Decoration, Indoor And Seasonal Outdoor



【Package List】

1 x Smart Light Curtain

1 x Remote Control

1 x Manual
App-Controlled 400-LED Smart Light for Seasonal Decor: This USB-powered 2M decorative string light set is designed for homeowners, renters and party hosts seeking customizable wall, porch or window lighting for holiday and event displays, with compatibility for both smartphone app and 32-button remote operation
Customizable DIY Text and Music-Synced RGB Effects for Event Backdrops: Individually addressable RGB LEDs support custom text greetings, 6 dynamic lighting modes, static color settings and audio-synced animation via the connected app, eliminating plain, one-note lighting for Christmas displays, birthday gatherings and patio parties
PVC-Coated Copper Build for Seasonal Outdoor Use: Sealed LED housings and PVC-insulated copper wiring support operation across a -4°F to 104°F temperature range, drawing only 10W of power from a standard 5V-2A USB port to deliver a rated 20,000 hour lifespan for repeated seasonal use
Clear Use Boundaries for Compatible Installation: This light fits covered porches, interior walls, windows, garden fences and patio railings for temporary seasonal display, but it is not intended for permanent year-round mounting, unprotected extreme weather exposure, or connection to light panels of a different model
Tool-Free Hanging With Automated Timer and Memory Function: The lightweight mesh panel attaches to surfaces via included quick-release hooks without additional hardware, with selectable 6-hour and 8-hour auto-shutoff timers and a built-in memory feature that restores your last used settings after power cycles.

Reusable Design

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details

The glitter finish is surface-treated to stay on, so the sparkle survives handling rather than migrating to hands and carpet. At about 25 by 20 cm it has real presence on the tree without looking like a satellite dish.

It suits most decoration styles, and it can be combined with string lights threaded through the hollow work for extra glow if the tree deserves it.

Open-work edges let tree lights glow through
Treated glitter finish stays where it is put

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Quantity: 20 pack.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your tree display.
Water resistant construction ensures durability and allows for easy cleaning after use.
Reusable design enables you to keep these decorations for festive seasons to come.
Includes a generous 20-pack quantity to fully decorate your Christmas tree.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use

5096042276966.sourceDescription:
Realistic pine and cypress-style sprigs are finished with velvet accents. The pair of 26 cm wreaths gives you two matching decorations for facing doors, separate windows or either side of a larger Christmas display. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Velvet catches light differently as the direction of the pile changes. A spot where daylight falls from one side gives the fabric a deeper colour in the folds and a softer highlight along its edges.

For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point.
Pair of 26 cm festive wreaths featuring realistic pine and cypress-style sprigs with velvet accents.
Versatile indoor and outdoor decoration suitable for hanging on doors, walls, or windows.
Complete one-piece outline design ideal for entrances where space for a tree is limited.
Red and green colour scheme with velvet trim adds a traditional touch to any Christmas display.
Comes with Pair of wreaths

Product Overview

 This pre-lit Christmas mailbox swag comes in 2 styles. 
 Features snow-flocked frosted pine branches, vivid red berries and natural pinecones, equipped with warm LED light strings.

Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display

The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.

PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team

STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
